item.title: Healdsburg Crush — Sun Oct 11, 12:00 PM — Bacchus Landing
item.description:
Raise a glass for a great cause at Healdsburg Crush, moving to a new iconic location, Bacchus Landing, on Sunday, October 11, 2026. Enjoy a rare chance to sip world-class wines all in one place at one of Sonoma County’s most beloved gathering spots. Sample Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, and Sparkling Wines from 60+ of California’s top producers, all in an open-air, walk-around format that celebrates the best of wine country. Enjoy VIP early access from 12–1pm, followed by General Admission from 1–4pm. Presented by and benefiting Boys & Girls Clubs of Sonoma-Marin, Healdsburg Crush supports life-changing programs for over 11,000 youth across the region. 100% of net proceeds go directly to these programs. Tickets and full details at healdsburgcrush.com. 21+ only. No children, strollers, or pets permitted.
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.title: Jazz in the Plaza — Sun Oct 11, 1:00 PM — Putnam Plaza
item.description:
Every Sunday: Free, live jazz every week performed by some of the best musicians in the SF Bay Area and beyond, right in the heart of downtown Petaluma! Every Sunday from 1 to 3:30, local jazz bassist and music book publisher Chuck Sher presents a rotating ensemble of professional, veteran jazz musicians in Putnam Plaza Park, right next to the Speakeasy. This event started in 2020 and has since become a staple for locals and visitors alike. Stop by and enjoy some of the best jazz the Bay Area has to offer!
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.title: Stu Allen & Mars Hotel (Keeping the Music of the Dead Alive) — Sun Oct 11, 6:00 PM — Inn at Occidental
item.description: The Inn at Occidental is proud to welcome back our Sunset Concert Series for 2026. item.description:

Discover the beauty of Raqs Sharqi (bellydance). This beginner-friendly class introduces you to foundational bellydance technique, including hip movements, isolations, undulations, traveling steps, combinations and musicality. You’ll develop coordination, body awareness, strength, and confidence while learning to move with greater ease and expression.
No previous dance experience is required. All bodies and experience levels are welcome.
Come move to the music, connect with your body, and discover the joy of bellydancing

Carem Love is a wellness advocate, professional dancer, and certified yoga instructor with a Bachelor’s degree in Dance. She has extensive training in Bellydance, a deep passion for Latin dance, and is certified in Hatha, Vinyasa, and Children’s Yoga.

item.title: Jewish Film Festival: The Last Twins — Tue Oct 13, 1:00 PM — Rialto Cinema Sebastapol
item.description:
The Last Twins is the never-before-told story of an unsung hero of the Holocaust, Erno “Zvi” Spiegel, who risked everything to save dozens of young twins from almost certain death at Auschwitz. Under the shadow of Dr. Josef Mengele’s horrific experiments, Spiegel used his courage, compassion, and ingenuity to shield the most vulnerable—the sets of twins targeted for brutal medical experimentation. Mengele put Spiegel in charge of the young boys, but Spiegel used his position to protect and comfort the children, all of whom had been torn from their families and subjected to inhumane tests under the constant threat of extermination.
Through first-hand testimony and exclusive archival material, The Last Twins brings to life the voices of those who survived because of Spiegel’s defiance. It is a testament to resilience, sacrifice, and the power of one person to make a difference, even in humanity’s darkest hour.

Join veteran canvassers and trainers Elizabeth Chur—author of [The Joy of Talking Politics with Strangers](https://elizabethchur.com/)—and Carol Blaney for this interactive one-hour workshop.
